questions.q: $∫ \dfrac{ln ⁡ \left(x + 1\right) - ln ⁡ x}{x\left(x + 1\right)}dx$ is equal to (where $C$ is an arbitarary constant)
questions.solution:
Put $ln ⁡ \left(x + 1\right) - ln ⁡ x = t$

$⇒ \dfrac{1}{x + 1} - \dfrac{1}{x} = \dfrac{dt}{dx} ⇒ \dfrac{x - \left(x + 1\right)}{x\left(x + 1\right)} = \dfrac{dt}{dx}$

$⇒ \dfrac{- dx}{x\left(x + 1\right)} = dt ⇒ \dfrac{dx}{x\left(x + 1\right)} = - dt$

so question becomes

$- ∫ tdt = - \dfrac{t^{2}}{2} + C$

questions.q: Let $f\left(x\right) = \dfrac{9x}{25} + c, c > 0 .$ If the curve $y = {f}^{- 1}\left(x\right)$ passes through $\left(\dfrac{1}{4}, - \dfrac{5}{4}\right)$ and g$\left(x\right) is the antiderivative of ${f}^{- 1}$\left(x\right)$ such that $g\left(0\right) = \dfrac{5}{2},$ then the value of $\left[g\left(1\right)\right]$ is, (where $[ . ]$ represents the greatest integer function)
questions.solution:
$y = f\left(x\right) = \dfrac{9x}{25} + {c}_{1}$
$⇒ x = \dfrac{25}{9}\left(y - {c}_{1}\right) = {f}^{- 1}\left(y\right)$
$⇒ {f}^{- 1}\left(x\right) = \dfrac{25}{9}\left(x - {c}_{1}\right)$
The curve $y = {f}^{- 1}\left(x\right)$ passes through $\left(\dfrac{1}{4}, - \dfrac{5}{9}\right)$
$⇒ - \dfrac{5}{9} = \dfrac{25}{9}\left(\dfrac{1}{4} - {c}_{1}\right)$
$⇒ {c}_{1} = \dfrac{1}{4} + \dfrac{1}{5} = \dfrac{9}{20}$
$⇒ {f}^{- 1}\left(x\right) = \dfrac{25}{9}\left(x - \dfrac{9}{20}\right)$ $= \dfrac{25x}{9} - \dfrac{5}{4}$
$g\left(x\right) = ∫ {f}^{- 1}\left(x\right)dx = ‍ ∫ \left(\dfrac{25x}{9} - \dfrac{5}{4}\right)dx‍$
$= \dfrac{25}{9}\left(\dfrac{{x}^{2}}{2}\right) - \dfrac{5x}{4} + {c}_{2}$
$g\left(0\right) = \dfrac{5}{2} ⇒ {c}_{2} = \dfrac{5}{2}$
$⇒ g\left(x\right) = \dfrac{25}{9}\left(\dfrac{{x}^{2}}{2}\right) - \dfrac{5x}{4} + \dfrac{5}{2}$
$⇒ g\left(1\right) = \dfrac{25}{18} - \dfrac{5}{4} + \dfrac{5}{2} = \dfrac{50 - 45 + 90}{36} = \dfrac{95}{36}$
$⇒ \left[g\left(1\right)\right] = 2$
